description: This file implements CRC calculation functions optimized with ARM NEON intrinsics, including functions for byte swapping, shifting, and folding data for CRC computation, as well as class methods for calculating CRC over byte, bit, and buffer data.

methods.name: neon_bswap
methods.description: Performs byte swap on a 128-bit NEON register.

methods.name: neon_shift_right
methods.description: Shifts a 128-bit NEON register to the right by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_right_4
methods.description: Shifts a 128-bit NEON register to the right by 4 bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_left
methods.description: Shifts a 128-bit NEON register to the left by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_left_4
methods.description: Shifts a 128-bit NEON register to the left by 4 bytes.

methods.name: neon_clear_lower_4byte
methods.description: Clears the lower 4 bytes of a 128-bit NEON register.

methods.name: neon_vmull_p64
methods.description: Performs polynomial multiplication on two 64-bit parts of NEON registers with an opcode.

methods.name: crc32_folding_round
methods.description: Performs a folding round in CRC calculation using NEON instructions.

methods.name: crc32_reduce_128_to_64
methods.description: Reduces a 128-bit NEON register to 64 bits in CRC calculation.

methods.name: neon_safe_load
methods.description: Safely loads data into a NEON register, handling spans of data.

methods.name: crc32_reduce_64_to_32
methods.description: Reduces a 64-bit NEON register to 32 bits in CRC calculation.

methods.name: neon_set_u64
methods.description: Creates a 128-bit NEON register from two 64-bit integers.

methods.name: crc32_calc_pclmulqdq
methods.description: Calculates CRC using polynomial multiplication and NEON instructions on data span.
